author: FrostedCupcakez
body:
Hey guys! This is a new map called Crumbled Avenue for the gamemode: Minotaur made by FrostedCupcakez, SomeonedoesMC, bpirr, lunax564 and UltraBubbles618. 

Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/mwlzw021i98qw45/Minotaur_TempleRun.rar
Thank you to alexanderjoe10 for providing the server and download! ^-^

Map Album: http://imgur.com/a/ECmLt

Map YML: Coming Soon! 

We'd love to hear some feedback! So leave some comments down below ^-^ Thanks!
